hero.tagline: I build fast, polished web interfaces with React and keep high-traffic sites running smoothly.

about.p1: I'm a web developer with 8+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications. I work across the stack, with a strong focus on JavaScript and React, plus PHP and MySQL on the backend.
about.p2: At CECyTEH, I develop and maintain the official institutional website, serving 20,000–40,000 visitors every month. Before that, at Enapsys, I shipped features in Scrum sprints with a multidisciplinary team: reusable components, multi-view routing, i18n and unit tests.
about.p3: Beyond code, I have hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta campaigns and working with Adobe creative tools, so I think about performance, conversion and design, not just features.

visitors.label: Monthly visitors on my main project

bullets: Develop and maintain the official institutional website, serving 20,000–40,000 visitors per month with JavaScript, jQuery, PHP and MySQL.
Build and update modules, features and interfaces based on requirements from different institutional areas.
Keep a high-traffic system running smoothly through ongoing maintenance, Git/GitHub version control and proactive incident resolution.
Strengthen collaboration across areas with tailored technical solutions and clear technical communication.
Delivered 10–20 tickets per 2-week sprint: bug fixes, new views and reusable components with React.js and Hooks.
Implemented multi-view navigation with React Router.
Worked in Scrum with multidisciplinary teams, managing code with Git/GitHub.
Improved product reliability by running unit tests in every development cycle.
Built a customer service bot, from requirements analysis and service integration to full technical documentation.
Facilitated the migration of the project's services with technical planning and detailed documentation that reduced transition risk.
